items.title: River Pamba at Malakkara in Pathanamthitta district of Kerala continues to flow in severe flood situation at 6:00 pm today.
items.description: River Pamba at Malakkara in Pathanamthitta district of Kerala continues to flow in severe flood situation at 6:00 pm today. At 6:00 pm, it was flowing at a level of 7.05 m with falling trend which is 0.05 m above its Danger Level of 7 m and 2.53 m below its previous HFL of 9.58 m (16/08/2018).
